title: Yellow Paint Pack
og_description: Download this package (10 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!

palette.notes: Single bright yellow on transparent/white; reads as hazard / caution / highlighter paint.

use_cases: Directional signage (arrows for UI or 3D scenes)
Decorative splatter, splash and drip VFX
Level decoration on platforms, blocks and walls
In-world stickers, badges or highlight markers
visual_summary: A set of 10 flat, vector-style yellow paint graphics: four dripping arrows (up, down, left, right), circular and irregular splat/splash blots, and three dripping paint bars/edges. Each asset has an irregular outline with downward drips, evoking fresh, wet, glossy paint. Delivered in PNG (transparent) and SVG (resolution-independent). Preview demonstrates the shapes applied as decals on white 3D blocks against a dark background.

zip_inventory.notes: PNGs are paletted (mode P) with transparent backgrounds; dimensions vary per sprite (irregular painted outlines, not uniformly sized).
